AC-0136 — Texture filtering: sharp NEAREST regression

Status: DONE. User-reported regression (2026-08-28): after AC-0128 switched opaque/cutout/flower/fluid chunk faces to the unlit chunk_lit_*.gdshader materials, block textures render bilinearly blurry instead of pixel-sharp. Fix = the authoritative : filter_nearest sampler hint on the tex sampler in all four shaders (1 line each). All gates green.

Root cause (which layer)

The cause is the shader-hint layer, not the texture-creation layer.

  • Godot 4.7.1: a uniform sampler2D tex; with no filter hint samples with the shader default LINEAR. AC-0128's four new shaders declared the sampler bare → every chunk face bilinear-blurred. Pre-AC-0128 the opaque/cutout/flower/fluid faces used StandardMaterial3D with texture_filter = NEAREST → sharp.
  • Texture-creation layer inspection (spec item 3): both runtime textures are plain ImageTextures — Data.atlas_tex (tint-baked at load, data.gd:222) and the per-chunk lit_atlas (ImageTexture.create_from_image, chunk.gd:101). Empirically verified in this engine build that 4.7.1 exposes NO filter API at all on ImageTexture/CompressedTexture2D/Texture2D (has_method("get_filter") = false, "filter" in tex = false; probe AWECRAFT_LOGIC=sharpx reports filter_api_exposed=false). So no creation-time NEAREST setting exists to have been missed — the sampler hint is the only filter authority. Recorded: cause layer = missing shader hint; creation layer = ImageTexture, no settable/inspectable filter.
  • chunk.gd:87 comment claims the NEAREST default — that claim is false in 4.7.1 and is what let AC-0128 ship blurry textures.

Out-of-scope audit (spec item 4) — no changes

  • fluid_anim material: godot/core/fluid_anim.gdshader:9 already declares uniform sampler2D tex : filter_nearest; → fluid surfaces were already sharp; the same regression does not apply there. Documented out-of-scope, nothing fixed, nothing registered.
  • Held-item / viewmodel materials: StandardMaterial3D copies in player/held_mesh.gd:77 (and player.gd viewmodel mirrors) retain their existing texture_filter = NEAREST — untouched, verified.

The fix (4 files × 1 line, FROZEN line verified)

godot/world/chunk_lit_opaque.gdshader
godot/world/chunk_lit_cutout.gdshader
godot/world/chunk_lit_flower.gdshader
godot/world/chunk_lit_fluid.gdshader
  - uniform sampler2D tex;
  + uniform sampler2D tex : filter_nearest;
FROZEN (byte-identical in all 4, grep-verified):
  float L = 0.20 + 0.80 * max(u_day * COLOR.r, COLOR.g);

G1 — pixel probe (AWECRAFT_LOGIC=sharpx, R=1, seed 44) + close-up renders

New env-gated probe: finds a lit outdoor wall face + an eff-0 cave face near spawn, poses the camera 2.5 m square-on, samples an 11-px strip across the highest-contrast atlas-texel boundary and classifies step (pure_nearest) vs ramp (blended_linear). Metric (v2): ramp pixels counted only within the predicted [a,b] texel window — the v1 run showed the ±5 strip reaches a 3rd texel when the boundary sits 2.5 px off the predicted center, which contaminated the count.

Deviations & findings

  1. MINFO −48 verts (run1) — merge-reshuffle flake class (run-to-run ±12/28 proven with no code change between runs; shaders cannot affect vertex counts; genhash byte-identical). Documented, not a regression.
  2. Micro-cave probe face missing from mesh — pre-existing local data/mesh inconsistency at the (6,20,6) 1-cell crack (face exposed per data, absent from render even with zero transients). Informational only; candidate input for the AC-0131/AC-0137 area, not registered (no new task per scope).
  3. Probe verdict metric v1→v2 — off-count now restricted to the predicted [a,b] window (v1 counted a 3rd-texel pixel when the boundary sat 2.5 px off-center → false "inconclusive" on a perfect step). PRE remains a valid blended_linear under both metrics (recorded strip).
  4. 3 renders (not 2) — sanctioned: POST close-up is an outdoor-noon wall, so the G2 midnight cave scene needed its own render (AC-0135 pose reused).
  5. threadgen_handoff transient (world.gd:474, Nil→PackedByteArray) observed in several render/boundary runs — known pre-existing, tracked AC-0137, not a failure; no OTHER script error in any run.
  6. 4.7.1 has no texture filter API — the "verify/align creation-layer filter" step resolved to: creation layer is ImageTexture with no filter setter/getter in this engine build; the sampler hint is the sole filter authority (chunk.gd:87's "NEAREST default" comment is false).
